title: Massachusetts patient-requested Schedule II partial fill
rule_summary: For the Massachusetts patient-requested Schedule II partial-fill pathway, the initial partial dispensing and later remainder are subject to statutory timing and same-pharmacy conditions.
exam_relevance: The rule tests the distinction between a Schedule II partial-fill remainder and a transferable refill.

numeric_facts.conditions: Patient-requested Massachusetts Schedule II partial-fill pathway
Patient-requested Massachusetts Schedule II partial-fill pathway

exceptions: Emergency, shortage, terminally ill, and LTCF partial-fill pathways have different predicates and must not be merged into this rule.
common_confusions: The remaining quantity is not a refill.
A different pharmacy location does not inherit the original pharmacy's remainder merely because fewer than 30 days have elapsed.
verification_notes: Exact Massachusetts statutory subsection checked on 2026-08-13.
